title: Slot occupancy identity
description: A slot number is a workstation; a working session is one occupancy of one worktree. After complete or teardown, the next launch may reuse the number but must mint a new occupancy — new purpose, new trajectory stream, no merge with the previous session key. Each station adds a question the gate keeps asking forever.

stations.title: Purpose does not survive a relaunch
stations.description: After idle sync, purpose is null; relaunching slot N does not keep occupancy A's summary.

stations.title: Trajectory and usage follow the occupancy
stations.description: Streams and usage rows for occupancy B are not listed under occupancy A of the same slot id.

stations.title: Ingest mints a new session
stations.description: complete then launch writes a new session key; ingest never prefers a stale har.session_key once the worktree changed.

stations.title: Prove it without a developer's laptop
stations.description: Two real occupancies of slot 1 driven by the real CLI against a real database, in a container with an isolated HOME.

extraStages.description: Docker sandbox occupancy lab — never on verify

handoff.waitFor: human review of the lab report before merge
